description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the average performance and tokens of CoUT and baselines for four LRMs over four benchmarks, displaying two primary metrics: Accuracy (%) and Token Count. The horizontal axis organizes the data into two distinct spatial clusters corresponding to these metrics, though it lacks an overall axis title. The chart features dual vertical value axes with linear scales. The left vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" at the top, with values ranging from 70 to 100 at intervals of 5, accompanied by faint dashed horizontal grid lines aligned to these ticks. The right vertical axis is labeled "Token Count" at the top, with values ranging from 0 to 800 at intervals of 100. A legend at the bottom maps four methods to specific bar colors: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). All bars feature a thin black outline and are visually emphasized with exact numerical annotations positioned directly above them. In the left cluster measuring Accuracy (%), read against the left axis, the red CoT bar is the tallest at 91.19, followed by the light blue CCoT bar at 88.50, the green CoUT bar at 88.40, and the orange CoD bar, which is the shortest in this group at 80.89. In the right cluster measuring Token Count, read against the right axis, the red CoT bar is the tallest at 676.85, followed by the orange CoD bar at 534.24, the light blue CCoT bar at 445.91, and the green CoUT bar, which is the shortest at 354.46. The bars within each cluster are consistently ordered from left to right according to the sequence in the legend (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT), a layout that results in a strictly descending height pattern within the Token Count group.
